verdict.rationale: The docs describe one-command installs: `/plugins` in Codex CLI opens the marketplace browser, `$skill-installer linear` installs a curated skill by name, and `codex plugin marketplace add` adds a marketplace source. They also say installed plugins' skills and tools are available after starting a new session, matching 'active in my next session'. A hands-on probe ran `npx skills add openai/plugins ...` and confirmed the skill landed in `.agents/skills`, which the docs say Codex scans automatically. Missing for 10: no hands-on check that an installed skill actually activates in a fresh Codex session (the probe only verified the files landed on disk).
